name: Total Liabilities
description: Total financial obligations owed to external creditors or allocated to an internal unit at the end of the period.

name: Total Equity
description: Residual value of the organisation's assets after deducting all liabilities.

name: Portfolio Equity
description: Ownership value held in a specific investment portfolio or fund.

name: Total Revenue
description: Total income earned from all operating activities in the period.

name: Product Revenue
description: Income earned from selling a specific product line or service.

name: Operating Expenses
description: Costs of running the core business, such as rent, salaries and administration, excluding cost of goods sold.

name: Facility Operating Costs
description: Running costs of buildings and sites, such as utilities, maintenance, insurance and property taxes.

name: Net Income
description: Earnings left after deducting all expenses, interest and taxes from revenue.

name: Project Net Income
description: Profit of a single project or contract after its direct and allocated indirect costs.

name: Quick Ratio
description: Liquid assets (cash, receivables, marketable securities) divided by current liabilities; excludes inventory.

name: Investment Amount
description: Total money placed in financial assets or investment projects.

name: Invoice Amount
description: Total amount due on issued invoices, including charges and taxes.

name: Inventory Amount
description: Value of goods and materials held in stock at a point in time.

name: Accounts Payable Due
description: Unpaid amounts owed to suppliers or to internal cost centres that are due for payment.

name: Accounts Receivable Outstanding
description: Amounts owed to the organisation by customers or tenants that have not yet been paid.

name: Tax Liability
description: Taxes owed to tax authorities, such as income, payroll and sales taxes, for the period.

name: Interest Income
description: Interest earned on loans, deposits, bonds or leases.

name: Inventory Turnover
description: Number of times stock is sold and replaced in a period, usually cost of goods sold divided by average inventory.

name: Capital Expenditure
description: Spending to acquire, upgrade or maintain long-term physical assets such as property, equipment and infrastructure.

name: Sales Revenue
description: Revenue from selling goods, by channel or combined across channels.

name: Website Traffic
description: Number of visits or visitors to websites and landing pages in a period.

name: Claims Settled
description: Number of insurance claims settled and paid out in a period.

name: Customer Churn Rate
description: Share of customers or subscribers who stop buying or cancel in a period.

name: Loan Default Rate
description: Share of loans in a portfolio that have defaulted.

name: Total Marketing Expenditure
description: Total budget or spend on marketing activities in a fiscal period.

name: Digital Marketing Budget
description: Budget for online marketing such as search, social media and content.

name: Advertising Spend
description: Amount spent on advertising across all channels in a period.

name: Total Product Sales
description: Overall revenue from selling products over a period.

name: Net Product Revenue
description: Product sales revenue after returns, allowances and discounts.

name: Gross Revenue from Product Sales
description: Product sales revenue before returns, allowances and discounts.

name: Employee Satisfaction Index
description: Survey-based index of how satisfied employees are with their work and employer.

name: Employee Engagement Score
description: Survey-based score of how engaged employees are with their work and company culture.

name: Staff Wellbeing Index
description: Index of employee health and wellbeing, based on wellness surveys and programmes.

name: Customer Satisfaction Score
description: Survey-based score of how satisfied customers are with a product or service.

name: Net Promoter Score
description: Percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors among customers asked how likely they are to recommend us.

name: Customer Experience Rating
description: Overall rating of customers' experience across their interactions with the organisation.

name: Operational Efficiency Ratio
description: How effectively resources are turned into output, usually operating costs relative to output or revenue.

name: Resource Utilization Rate
description: Share of available resources, such as labour, machines or materials, that is used productively.

name: Productivity Rate
description: Output produced per unit of input, such as per hour worked.

name: Total Shipping Expenses
description: Costs incurred to ship products to customers.

name: Freight Costs
description: Costs of transporting goods between locations, such as from suppliers to warehouses and stores.

name: Delivery Charges
description: Fees charged to customers for delivering their orders.

name: Order Total
description: Total value of orders including tax.

name: Large Orders
description: Number of orders whose total is above a set threshold.

name: Orders
description: Number of orders placed.

name: Food Orders
description: Number of orders that contain at least one food item.

name: Orders Last 7 Days
description: Rolling number of orders placed over the last seven days.

name: Revenue
description: Product revenue from order lines, excluding tax.

name: Order Cost
description: Cost of the items sold in orders.

name: Median Revenue
description: Median product revenue per order line, excluding tax.

name: Food Revenue
description: Revenue from food items in orders.

name: Food Revenue %
description: Share of order revenue that comes from food items.

name: Revenue Growth % M/M
description: Percentage change in revenue compared with the previous month.

name: Order Gross Profit
description: Order revenue minus the cost of the items sold.

name: Cumulative Revenue
description: Running total of revenue since the start of records.

name: Customers with Orders
description: Number of distinct customers who placed at least one order.

name: New Customers
description: Number of distinct customers placing their first order.

name: Turnover
description: Money taken from sales in a period; divisions differ on tax, refunds and when a sale counts.

name: Active Users
description: Number of customers or users counted as active over a recent window; divisions differ on what counts as activity.

name: Average Turnover per Active User
description: Turnover divided by active users for the same period: average turnover per active user.
